rationale.consistency: Mirrors CookieFilter exactly: reuses cookieFilterAction, Validate, module ID naming, receiver names, init registration and interface assertions in the right spots.
rationale.edge_cases: Unparseable lines, no-match, delete, quoted values, empty/nil field all handled; exact name match. Minor: rebuilding from c.Name drops any leading whitespace or space before the first ';' rather than being fully verbatim.
rationale.scope: Focused on the one filter; the extra []string case in the type switch is unrequested but harmless, no unrelated edits.
rationale.readability: Clear flow and names; the delete branch handled outside the switch plus an unreachable default inside it is slightly awkward, otherwise easy to follow.
rationale.robustness: No panics possible, input slice is not mutated, stdlib http.ParseSetCookie does the parsing, unknown action types fall through safely.
rationale.maintainability: UnmarshalCaddyfile is a verbatim copy of CookieFilter's rather than a shared helper; this matches existing codebase practice but doubles the maintenance surface for the Caddyfile shape.
